subject: general
question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12820df22fa0a9cbccc8149602af91922bd6c8eafbd0d258591d4188730e5065.png] 

What is the difference between the production of rice in state C in 2016 and the production of rice in state B in 2019.
solution:
**Given:**

The graph shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12820df22fa0a9cbccc8149602af91922bd6c8eafbd0d258591d4188730e5065.png] 

**Calculations:**

Production of rice in state C in year 2016 = 45, 00, 000 tonnes

Production of rice in state B in year 2019 = 55, 00, 000 tonnes

So, The difference between the production of rice in state C in 2016 and production of rice in state B in 2019 is

= (55, 00, 000 - 45, 00, 000)Tonnes

= 10, 00, 000 Tonnes

**Hence, The Required difference is 10, 00, 000 tonnes.**
